v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Cor contrítum * et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
text.en: A contrite and a humbled heart, * O God, thou wilt not despise.

text.la: Propter nomen tuum, * Dómine, vivificábis me in æquitáte tua.
text.en: For thy name's sake, * O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice.

text.la: Deus, tu convérsus * vivificábis nos, et plebs tua lætábitur in te.
text.en: Thou wilt turn, O God, * Thou wilt quicken us and bring us to life.

text.la: Cum irátus fúeris, * Dómine, misericórdiæ recordáberis.
text.en: When thou art angry, * O Lord, thou wilt remember mercy.

text.la: Lauda * Deum tuum, Sion, qui annúntiat iudícia sua Israël.
text.en: Praise thy God, * O Sion, who declareth his judgments to Israel.

text.la: Clama, ne cesses, quasi tuba exálta vocem tuam, et annúntia pópulo meo scélera eórum, et dómui Iacob peccáta eórum.
text.en: Cry, cease not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and show my people their wicked doings, and the house of Jacob their sins.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Aquam, quam ego dédero, * si quis bíberit ex ea, non sítiet in ætérnum.
text.en: Whosoever drinketh * of the water that I shall give him, shall never thirst.

text.la: Ieiúnia nostra, quǽsumus, Dómine, benígno favóre proséquere: ut, sicut ab aliméntis abstinémus in córpore; ita a vítiis ieiunémus in mente.
text.en: Lord, we beseech thee graciously to bless this our Fast, that we who are now outwardly denying meats to our bodies, may have power inwardly to keep our souls fasting from all sin.

text.la: Gábriel Angelus descéndit ad Zacharíam, et ait illi: Uxor tua páriet tibi fílium, et vocábis nomen eius Ioánnem, et multi in nativitáte eius gaudébunt: ipse enim præíbit ante fáciem Dómini paráre vias eius.
text.en: The Angel Gabriel came down unto Zacharias, and said unto him: Thy wife shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John, and many shall rejoice at his birth; for he shall go before the face of the Lord, to prepare His ways.

v.en: An Angel stood at the Altar of the Temple.

r.la: Habens thuríbulum áureum in manu sua.
r.en: Having a golden censer in his hand.

text.la: Deus, qui inter céteros Angelos, ad annuntiándum Incarnatiónis tuæ mystérium, Gabriélem Archángelum elegísti: concéde propítius; ut qui festum eius celebrámus in terris, ipsíus patrocínium sentiámus in cælis:
text.en: O God, Who didst choose the Archangel Gabriel from among all Thine other Angels, and send him to herald the mystery of Thine Incarnation, mercifully grant that we who keep his feast upon earth may feel his protection in heaven.

office.title: Feria Sexta infra Hebd III in Quadr
